correctness.rationale: Fourier diagonalization of full-translation frame operator gives eigenvalues |P(zeta^{j-l0})|^2+|P(zeta^{j-l1})|^2. Orthogonality of lags 0,±1,±2 for N>=5 yields exact Φ=4N+8N[|a*conj(b)+b*conj(c)|² t_d+u²w²(2t_d-1)²]. Expansion |C1|²=v²(u-w)²+4uv²w cos²(arg(ac/b²)/2) determines all phase minima; strict convex quadratic A*t+B(2t-1)² picks nearest sampled cos²(pi*d/N) to tau=max(0,(4B-A)/(8B)). Potential Φ=4N iff u=w,4|N,d=N/4, relative phase pi. Shared unit-circle zeros for two modulation values would force b²/(ac)>=0 or b=0 for antipodal gap, incompatible with optimal phases/positive taps, proving each optimizer is a frame. Independently compared direct 2N-atom frame operator to potential formula across N=5,8,11 and all allowed gaps, a supplementary bounded test.
